108 --- Page 9 --- JANAPANI Sonatchi aro Kalsinni dakmesokaniko 1937-38 bilsirangoni intalan Achik a-songni salgro Jolo chong'motan Penchimari, Rongchipatpara, Moskuli, Derek (Assam) aro gipin biaprangoba dakmesoke mesokaha.
Haida, ua sonatchi aro Kalsinni golpoko Bengali oikorchi, Pa Upendro Ch.
Momin sechengaha ine nikaha, 1930 bilsirangon matchotna nangaha.
Kalsin aro Sonatchini ginin chu-ginik uamangni kam aro kattarangni gimin dakmesokani aganbewalo seaha.
Iandakgipa Kalsin aro sonatchini dakmesokani chu'soksrange knalo an'chingni A'chik bi'sarangna u'i ma'sirike ra'rikchina donangenga maina iandakdipa dakmesokanirang jatni gisepoda'o gimaangengaha.
Kalsin aro Sonatchini gimin a'sel chong'mot banoni aro nai mai ong-achim u'ina aro ma'sina dakdilchenggiparango, me'apa chagitchamrango sing-sandie aro sandirikote jeko man'a talatenga.
A'chikrang rokomari dakmcsokanirangko dakmesokna, chrok mesana, git rigng'na, ring'ringna aro daksningna changgiparang ong'a.
Indiba, iarang plakko daksninge dakmesokna chol ong-pagijaniodongjripna nangaha.
Sonatchi aro Kalsinni daknesokaniko skanggipa dakdilchenggiparangoni Pa Nogen Sangma jolrangoni ahachengskaha.
Ja'manode ka'sine ka'sine gipin biaprangonaba,Jemangan rokomari nika nianirang A'chik a'songonaba gipbaanichi, 1980 jolrangoni intal ka'sine ka'sine bonangaha.
Ia daknesokanrangara jatni mingsa nambegipa dakbewalko dakmesokani ong'achim.
Haida, ia kitap saoba jatni gisepo iandakgipa dakmesokanirangko ripingangna sikgiparangna dakchakani ong'naba donga ine chanchiesa chu'gimik dakmesokaniko seaha.
landakgipa chanchibewalani kalta aro kamko ripingna knalona jotton ka'na.

Sonatchi aro Kalsinni gimin plak katta bichongrangko agan talate on'e angko Kalsin aro Sonatchini dakmesokaniko anga an'tangan songni me'apa, me'chikma aro dakmesokaniko dakdilgiparango sing'sandie seaha.
Uamangni gimin bang'an, ma'sina aro talna man'jaha.Redin Momin,Sonatchi aroKalsinni gimin golponi bimango seaha indiba dakmesokani bimango dongkuja.
Uni a'bachengo dakdilchenggipa dakmesokani seanirangko sandie nie aro (i） --- Page 10 --- on'dapatanikoon'akusiongbegen.
